claim: Larrabetzu has two Michelin-starred restaurants: Azurmendi (3 stars) and Eneko (1 star); no 2-star restaurant exists in the town
quote: Azurmendi – Three Stars: Exceptional cuisine, worth a special journey. Eneko – One Star: High quality cooking, worth a stop.

claim: Azurmendi is a 3-Michelin-star restaurant in Larrabetzu directed by chef Eneko Atxa, open Tue–Sat lunch and Fri–Sat dinner
Azurmendi offers two menus: Adarrak at €315 and Gran Menú at €350 (VAT included); wine pairing €150 or premium €300
quote: Adarrak (The Branches) €315 | Gran Menú €350 | Wine pairing €150 | Premium wine selection €300

claim: Eneko Larrabetzu is a 1-star restaurant by Eneko Atxa featuring the Sutan tasting menu with open live cooking, Wed–Sun lunch and Fri–Sat dinner
quote: Open menu cooked live, full of flavor, technique, and tradition. Wednesday-Sunday 1:00pm–3:15pm; Friday-Saturday 8:30pm–9:15pm

claim: Eneko received its Michelin star in November 2017 (Spain & Portugal 2018 guide), giving chef Eneko Atxa four stars collectively
quote: ENEKO restaurant in Larrabetzu received one Michelin star in the Spain & Portugal 2018 Michelin Guide

claim: Eneko Atxa operates Azurmendi (★★★) and Eneko Larrabetzu (★) plus restaurants in Tokyo, Karuizawa, Seville, Madrid and Bilbao
quote: Azurmendi ★★★ Larrabetzu | ENEKO Larrabetzu ★ | ENEKO Tokyo | ENEKO Karuizawa

claim: Azurmendi holds a 4.7/5 TripAdvisor rating from 1,346 reviews; praised for immersive multi-space journey and sustainability values
quote: Rating: 4.7 of 5 bubbles (1,346 reviews). One reviewer called it 'one of the best dining experiences ever experienced'

claim: Eneko Larrabetzu holds a 4.3/5 TripAdvisor rating from 283 reviews; Sutan tasting menu priced at €90–96
quote: Rating: 4.3 of 5 bubbles (283 reviews). Sutan tasting menu: €90-96. #2 of 9 Larrabetzu restaurants

claim: Azurmendi's tasting menu is listed at 300€; Eneko Larrabetzu at 77€ (older figure); no 2-star restaurants exist in Larrabetzu specifically
quote: Azurmendi (Larrabetzu) 300€ tasting menu. Eneko Larrabetzu provides excellent cooking at 77€, a more accessible fine dining choice.

claim: Azurmendi earned LEED Gold certification and was crowned World's Most Sustainable Restaurant in 2014 and 2018; building uses geothermal energy, solar panels, and rainwater irrigation with 50% energy savings
quote: LEED Gold-certified Azurmendi crowned 'World's Most Sustainable Restaurant'. Building achieves 50% energy savings via geothermal and photovoltaic solar panels.

claim: Azurmendi earned 3 Michelin stars in just 5 years; reviewer awarded 9/10 citing exceptional consistency; notable dishes include truffle egg yolk and roasted lobster
quote: Eneko Atxa earned Azurmendi three Michelin stars in just five years. Reviewer awarded 9/10, citing exceptional consistency across courses.

claim: Eneko Atxa opened Azurmendi in 2005, earned 3rd Michelin star in 2012 (first in Biscay), won National Gastronomy Award for Best Chef in 2016
quote: 2005: Opened Azurmendi. 2012: Achieved three Michelin stars, becoming 'the first and only restaurant in Biscay to obtain this distinction'

claim: Azurmendi ranked #49 in World's 50 Best Restaurants 2021 and received the Highest Climber Award in 2019 (+29 places)
quote: No. 49 in The World's 50 Best Restaurants 2021. Received the Highest Climber Award in 2019 after rising 29 places.

claim: Gorka Izagirre txakoli winery shares the same address (Barrio Legina s/n, Larrabetzu) as Azurmendi and Eneko; run by Eneko Atxa's uncle Gorka, cultivating 40 hectares across 6 Biscay municipalities
quote: Barrio Legina s/n, 48195 Larrabetzu (Bizkaia). Hamaiketako experience — a late morning snack that the Basque people typically enjoy before sitting down for lunch.

claim: Gorka Izagirre winery was co-founded in 2005 by Eneko Atxa and his uncle Gorka to rejuvenate Larrabetzu at both winemaking and gastronomic levels
quote: In 2005, the owners of the restaurant Azurmendi, Eneko and his uncle, Gorka, designed the actual project to rejuvenate the area at a winemaking and a gastronomic level.

claim: Azurmendi is the sole 3-star Michelin restaurant in Larrabetzu according to the 2026 Michelin Guide Spain
quote: Three Stars: Exceptional cuisine, worth a special journey — Azurmendi, Larrabetzu
